stats.Effect: The leader of the devils trying to occupy the Tower of Insolence. He strives to obtain the secret knowledge hidden in the Tower of Insolence and use it as a bridgehead to expand the power of devils. But he expended too much power trying to break a seal of the Tower, and is now weak. He is enemies with the angels and the Platinum tribe protecting the Tower of Insolence at the command of Einhasad. He has three loyal subordinates: Kernon, Rahha, and Verfa.
